subject: GreenWave security kickoff & buyer/owner commitments
messages:
From: Olivia Matthews <olivia.matthews@greenwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Security kick-off — GreenWave AI inference eval

Thanks for the call earlier — good to meet the team. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can get the security intake moving: 

- Primary goal: validate data boundaries and controls for GreenWave's pilot using Redwood for embeddings + real-time inference.
- Key internal players: Daniel Price (CFO) will own commercial approval; Maya Singh (Head of ML Ops) will be the technical owner; Procurement (procurement@greenwave.ai) handles contracts. I'm leading the security review.

Can you send the standard security questionnaire and a short list of exactly which systems you expect will be in scope (APIs, data stores, third-party integrations)? Procurement also asked for an estimated timeline and PO process overview.

I've attached a high-level network diagram for context. Proposed next step: security kickoff call w/ our SecOps + your security lead next week (Oct 12-14).

Thanks,
Olivia Matthews
Director, Security Operations
GreenWave Health

Attachments: greenwave_network_overview.png (image)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Matthews <olivia.matthews@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Security kick-off — GreenWave AI inference eval

Olivia — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the diagram. Quick internal recap and commitments from our side: 

- Economic buyer: noted as Daniel Price (CFO) — we'll include commercial timeline items for Procurement.
- Technical owner: Maya Singh — we'll loop her into the technical kickoff notes once she confirms availability.
- Security reviewer: Olivia (you) — you'll be our point for evidence requests and scope confirmation.

Immediate deliverables from Redwood:
1) Security questionnaire (attached) — please complete or flag items that need clarification.
2) Evidence pack we can provide quickly: SOC 2 Type II summary, infra architecture diagram, sample data flow for embedding storage.
3) Proposed in-scope systems (please confirm):
   - Redwood API endpoints that will receive PHI-containing payloads (embedding + inference)
   - Short-term embeddings store (encrypted at rest)
   - Customer-facing web app and analytics pipeline that will consume inference outputs

Timeline (proposed):
- Questionnaire returned by GreenWave: Oct 8
- Security kickoff call: Oct 12-13
- Evidence handoff: Oct 14-18
- Procurement/PO discussions: starts Oct 18 (aligned with your procurement team)

I've attached our security_questionnaire_v1.pdf for intake. Who on your side will be responsible for returning the questionnaire? Also, is an NDA already in place or should we route one?

Next steps: if Oct 12 works for you, we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Olivia Matthews <olivia.matthews@greenwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Price <daniel.price@greenwave.ai>, procurement@greenwave.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Security kick-off — GreenWave AI inference eval

Sergio — thanks, that aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from SecOps and Procurement: 

1) Systems we expect to include in the formal security scope (please confirm):
   - EHR sync service (bi-directional; contains PHI)
   - Real-time inference API that will accept patient identifiers
   - Embeddings store used for similarity/search (contains pseudonymized patient vectors)
   - Analytics pipeline (non-PHI aggregate metrics only)

2) Procurement note: please include an estimated order-of-magnitude for monthly token usage so we can map to budget. Procurement also sent a short PO process doc (attached) and asked whether Redwood requires a standard greenwave PO or a specific invoice flow.

3) Questionnaire: Maya Singh will own returning the questionnaire (Maya copied separately once she returns from travel). If you can mark which questions require architecture diagrams or live demos, that will speed things up.

We are generally available Oct 12 afternoon PT for a kickoff. Can you propose a 45-minute slot?

Thanks,
Olivia

Attachments: PO_process_overview.docx (docx)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Matthews <olivia.matthews@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Security kick-off — GreenWave AI inference eval

Perfect — thanks for the scope confirmation. Closing the loop here and adding a few clarifications so procurement/legal have clear asks before kickoff: 

Confirmed in-scope systems (Redwood will treat as priority for evidence and controls):
- Inference API (ingest endpoints that may carry PHI) — we'll document auth schemes, request/response filters, and retention policy.
- Embeddings store — encrypted at rest with rotation policy; we'll provide sample retention config and anonymization strategy for vectors.
- EHR sync is out of Redwood's direct control but will be included in the data-flow diagrams to show ingress/egress boundaries.
- Analytics pipeline flagged as out-of-scope for PHI controls (only aggregate metrics) but included in component map.

Requests for GreenWave prior to kickoff:
- Completed security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (or highlight which items need follow-up)
- Any specific compliance templates you require (e.g., custom BAA language)
- Contact for PO initiation (procurement@greenwave.ai is fine) and an estimated MOU/PO timeline

Proposed kickoff: Oct 12, 3:00pm PT — 45 minutes. Agenda: introductions, confirm owners, review in-scope systems & data flows, timeline for evidence handoff. I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

Links for prep: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6789012), GreenWave evidence folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GWave-Security-Evidence).

If an NDA is needed please point to the right contact; otherwise we can proceed with the questionnaire and evidence exchange under standard confidentiality.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Sergio
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132
